main_text.l: næ beneficio crux Domini tum reperta: quæ neq; in principio obstitentibus ludę-is potuerat confecrari, & poltea dirutæ civitatis opprella ruderibus, non nisi tam fideliter requirenti meruit oftendi. Igitur Helena primum de loco passionis certior facta, admota militari manu, atq; omnium provincialium multitudine in studia re-ginæ certantium, effodi terram, & conti- gua quæq; ac vastissima ruinarum purgari jubet: mox pretium fidei & laboris tres pariter cruces, sic ut olim Domino ac la- tronibus duobus fixæ fuerant, reperiun-tur. Hic vero major dignoscendi patibuli, in quo Dominus pependerat, difficultas omnium animos mentesque turbaverat, ne errore mortalium forsitan pro cruce Domini latronis patibulum confecra-rent. Capiunt deinde consilium, ut ali-quem recens mortuum crucibus admo-verent. Nec mora, quasi Dei nutu{a} funeris extincti solemnibus exequiis deferebatur concursuq; omnium ferretro corpus eripitur. Duabus prius frustra crucibus admotis, ubi Christi patibulo attactum est, dictu mirabile, trepidantibus cunctis {b}funus excussum, & inter spectatores

page.notes: Mark {a} placed after "nutu" in the text, where a superscript a stands. "defereba" ends the line and "tur," opens the next with no printed hyphen; written whole as "deferebatur". "poltea" is uncertain. The marginal note beside "ad Severi" is doubtful. The notes "Nicephe.l." and "8.cap.29." are doubtful. "Cassiodo-rus lib.2." and "Theod. l." are doubtful. "Sig." is an unclear marginal mark. The catchword "suos" stands at the right below the last line.
